project_overview: This Vue.js project appears to be a web application likely focused on educational services, potentially related to exam management and student interaction. The application utilizes a component-based architecture, as evidenced by the numerous `.vue` files, with a clear routing system managed through Router push operations. The core functionality seems centered around handling exam submissions, results, and user interactions with course catalogs. Further investigation is required to determine the precise business domain and the full scope of the application’s features.

layers.description: Handles user interface and user interactions.
Contains the core application logic and services.

macro_trends.title: Potential UI/Logic Coupling in ApplicationServices
macro_trends.description: The frequent Router push operations to 'ApplicationServices' (across multiple files) suggests a potential coupling between presentation and business logic. This could introduce fragility and hinder independent development or testing. Investigation should focus on whether this 'ApplicationServices' component truly encapsulates complex business rules or simply acts as a central dispatcher for routing and data retrieval.

macro_trends.title: Accessibility Concerns – High Issue Density
macro_trends.description: The substantial number of accessibility and UI/logic issues identified within several key files (ExamFormSubmission, HallTicketPage, iLikeCoursesNew, viewMarksheet) points to a significant need for a standardized accessibility review process and potentially a lack of dedicated UI/UX expertise. Addressing these issues is critical for usability and compliance.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow begins with user input through forms (ExamFormSubmission, FeeDetails), utilizes Router navigation to the appropriate view (SelectedApplicationService, ApplicationServices) and handles the final display of results (ResultPage, viewMarksheet). This represents a critical pathway for data integrity and user experience.

key_workflows.name: User Course Discovery
key_workflows.description: The ‘iLike’ related components (iLikeCourses, iLikeCoursesNew, iLikeLanding, iLikeDashboard) manage user's preferences and course discovery. Router navigation links these components together and ensures a smooth journey for users looking for courses.
